servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when compressing the accessory drive belt tensioner can cause damage to the tensioner.

item.ptxt: Do not apply a force of more than 150 N·m (15.3 kgf-m, 111.0 lbf-ft) when compressing the tensioner.
Do not apply more force when the tensioner stops at full stroke.

s1.ptxt: Remove accessory drive belt upper tensioner (1).

topic.title: Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection:K12D

topic.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: For Type 4, tighten accessory drive belt upper tensioner bolts (1) to specified torque.
For Type 5, install accessory drive belt upper tensioner as follows.
Put accessory drive belt upper tensioner and tighten the bolts temporarily.
Push the tensioner in arrow direction and fix the position by tightening the tensioner bolts.
Tighten accessory drive belt upper tensioner bolts to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Accessory drive belt upper tensioner bolt

item.ptxt: If replaced accessory drive belt upper tensioner with new one, remove lock pin from the tensioner.

s1.ptxt: Remove accessory drive belt lower tensioner (2).

topic.title: Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection:K12D

topic.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Tighten accessory drive belt lower tensioner bolts (1) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Accessory drive belt lower tensioner bolt

item.ptxt: If replaced accessory drive belt lower tensioner with new one, remove lock pin from the tensioner.

servinfosub.title: Accessory Drive Belt Idler Pulley and Bracket (Non-A/C Model)

s1.ptxt: Remove accessory drive belt idler pulley (1) and bracket (2).

topic.title: Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Accessory Drive Belt Tensioner / Idler Pulley Inspection:K12D

topic.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Tighten accessory drive belt idler bracket bolts (1) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Accessory drive belt idler bracket bolt

item.ptxt: Tighten accessory drive belt idler pulley bolts (2) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Accessory drive belt idler pulley bolt
